name: ProcurementFaq
description: Visible answers for procurement, legal and finance teams: contracting party, supplier verification, invoicing, agreements, ownership, languages, location, accessibility law and AI use.

keyboard: Tab reaches each question trigger; Enter or Space toggles its answer.
ariaRequirements: The section is labelled by its heading.
Answers stay in the DOM when collapsed (inert and hidden from assistive technology) so the visible content matches the FAQ structured data.

headingLevel.description: Heading level of the section title.

className.description: Additional class name on the section.

forbiddenUse: Publish a policy answer the owner has not confirmed.
Emit FAQ structured data for questions that are not rendered on the page.
dense: Visible procurement FAQ (9 locale items, Accordion divided); its English items feed the FAQPage data of the pages that render it

usage.description: Shown on the engagement pages and Pricing (not the homepage, owner decision 2026-10-16). app/lib/procurementFaq.ts reads the same English items for FAQPage structured data.
